lines.en: I walk with my tail held high.

lines.zh: 我的六条腿踩在烫沙上。
lines.en: My legs step on the hot sand.
I go round a clump of dry grass.
My pincers hang in front of me.
I walk in the dune's shadow.
I test each step, careful.
I sidle in your direction.

lines.zh: 沙从我的背甲上滑下去。
lines.en: Sand slides off my back plates.
My tail points ahead.
I crawl slowly over a stone.

lines.zh: 沙漠的沙，我踩得比谁都实。
lines.en: On desert sand my steps land solid.
I come half out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我把身后的沙痕拖得很长。
lines.en: My trail drags long behind me.
I head for the shade.
I turn half a circle to face you.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙里，只有尾巴在动。
lines.en: I lie in the sand; only my tail moves.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的背甲晒得很烫。
lines.en: The sun bakes my back plates.
I wait for something to come near.

lines.zh: 沙上有一道细小的动静。
lines.en: There's a small movement in the sand.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一下一下地晃。
lines.en: My tail sways in slow arcs.
I don't need water.
I clean my mouthparts with a pincer.

lines.zh: 风把沙粒吹进我的甲缝。
lines.en: The wind blows grit into my seams.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙里，跟石头一样。
lines.en: I lie in the sand as still as stone.

lines.zh: 沙下的暗处，我的眼在亮。
lines.en: In the dark under the sand, my eyes glow.
You stepped on the sand beside me.
I raise my tail higher.
I'm watching whether you reach out.
I sidle slowly away.
Step on me and I'll sting.

lines.zh: 沙地上，我的影子几乎没形。
lines.en: On the sand, my shadow has almost no shape.
There's a lot of water in you.
I'm waiting for you to move off a bit.
My back plate splits, oozing slime.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，尾巴还举着。
lines.en: I curl up, tail still raised.
One of my legs is crushed.
I slowly open out again.
I raise it again.
I can still crawl like this.
Shell's cracked. I can still pinch.
The desert will remember for me.
That smells of iron — I won't eat it.

lines.zh: 我举着钳子看了一会儿。
lines.en: I hold my pincers up and watch a while.
One nudge of a pincer and it rolls off.
That won't draw me out.
The sun has dried it out.
I sidle half a step away.
I turn my head away, uninterested.
I only want you further off.
My pincer knocks your leg.
I turn aside, tail still up.
Six legs scrabble and I right myself.
A sheet of sand rises.
I retreat flat along the sand.
I didn't sting you.
I raise my tail again.
I just hold still there.
She carries her tail high too.

lines.zh: 我们在沙丘后面碰了碰钳子。
lines.en: Our pincers touch behind the dune.
Her plates are paler than mine.
We lie together in the sand.

lines.zh: 她的尾巴尖碰了碰我的。
lines.en: Her tail tip touches mine.
We keep still and the sand covers us.
She heads east.

lines.zh: 我在原地又伏了一会儿。
lines.en: I lie there a while longer.
This sand is enough for both of us.
At night we each come out.
I take it in my pincers.
It crumbles in my grip.
I bring it to my mouthparts.
No scent at all — I'll hold it anyway.
I carry it two steps.
This shell is too hard for my pincers.
It slips from my pincers.
I leave it alone.
Something is coming near.
I raise my tail as high as it goes.
Both pincers open wide.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖上有一点湿。
lines.en: There's a bead of wet at my tail tip.
The sand shifts under me.
I've fixed its position.
Sand rustles under my pincers.
I start swinging my tail.
This sting has to land.
I follow sideways.
I hold my pincers out front.
It hasn't found me in the sand.

lines.zh: 我从沙里过去，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I cross the sand with only my eyes showing.
It stops; I stop.
My tail is up and steady.
It turns; I freeze.
It moves on again.

lines.zh: 沙漠的蝎，离它只有两步。
lines.en: A desert scorpion, two steps from it.
It's starting to come close.
I drive my tail forward.
I've worked out the tail's angle.
I snap a pincer shut.
My tail stings in.
That numbs it.
It throws me off and backs two paces.
I lunge once more.
My pincer takes its leg.
It stamps; I sink into the sand.
The tail stings again.
It can't stand steady now.
Then the two pincers.

lines.zh: 我把自己从沙里拖出来。
lines.en: I drag myself out of the sand.

lines.zh: 沙面鼓起一个小包，是我。
lines.en: A small bump in the sand — that is me.
It's dry here — good.
The dune's shadow falls just right.
I test my pincers.

lines.zh: 我朝最近的那片阴影走。
lines.en: I head for the nearest shade.
The sand still burns my feet.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，我往沙底钻。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell and I dig down.

lines.zh: 我摔在硬沙上，甲响了一声。
lines.en: I land on hard sand and my shell rings.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的背，我往上爬。
lines.en: Water covers my back; I climb up.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀出去，埋在沙里。
lines.en: The blast throws me and buries me in sand.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的甲缝。
lines.en: Something sharp goes into a seam.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的尾巴僵住。
lines.en: The light stiffens my tail.
Too starved to lift my tail.

lines.zh: 雷落在沙上，我缩进坑里。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and I shrink into a hollow.

lines.zh: 下面没有沙，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No sand below; I keep falling.
